## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
EGFR, SLCO2B1 
## Indications (Open Targets) 
 
Adenocarcinoma of pancreas, Non-small cell lung cancer, liver cancer (Phase 2), prostate cancer (Phase 2), urinary bladder cancer (Phase 2), hypopharynx squamous cell carcinoma (Phase 1/2), hepatocellular carcinoma (Phase 3), glioblastoma (Phase 2), esophageal adenocarcinoma (Phase 2), gastric cardia adenocarcinoma (Phase 2), germ cell tumor (Phase 2), biliary tract cancer (Phase 2)
